title: Elegy to a Missing Friend
overview: In the aftermath of her friend's passing, an artist processes her grief by making a film. She weaves her personal archival footage and an unfinished science-fiction narrative into a deeply raw and emotive work of art.

title: Battle of Molodinsk
overview: The year is 1572. A year after the burning of Moscow by the army of the Crimean Khanate, the enemy is on the way again. Now the goal of the Crimean Khan is the complete seizure of power in the Moscow state. The Russian army is stuck in battles on the western front, the Terrible Tsar is in Novgorod. Moscow is defended by a small army. To resist enslavement, the oprichniks detachments unite with the regular army. Having cunningly pulled the enemy horde of the Crimean Khan Devlet Giray away from Moscow, the squad, led by the voivodes Vorotynsky and Hvorostinin, takes the blow.

title: Margie Claus
overview: When Santa goes missing Christmas Eve, his wife Margie Claus has to assemble a rag-tag team of long-retired reindeer to rescue Santa and save Christmas

title: Capitão Adriano
overview: Biographical film about Adriano da Nóbrega, a former BOPE officer who became one of the most dangerous and controversial figures in Rio de Janeiro's criminal underworld.

title: Naughty
overview: To secure custody of her son from her ex, Mallory's only hope is to find Santa Claus and convince him to testify in her divorce hearing.

title: Charlie vs. the Chocolate Factory
overview: Years after his famous candy contest, Willy Wonka returns to his factory, where a new wave of "rotten" kids is plotting to nab a priceless chocolate bar.

title: 5H48, Place des Martyrs
overview: In Le Havre, just like every morning, the 5:48 a.m. bus leaves Place des Martyrs to begin its route, driven by Gilles, a quiet and exhausted driver. This morning, at his wits’ end, despised by the authorities and abandoned by his wife, he takes his passengers hostage. While the police and media rush to the scene, inside the bus, the hostages, grappling with the same distress as Gilles, may not be so innocent after all…

title: Seasons
overview: A husband and wife buy their dream ranch, only to discover the land is alive with ancient spirits, and that survival means submitting to increasingly disturbing rituals with each turn of the season.

title: Treasure Island
overview: A young boy uncovers the map to a legendary buried treasure, and he embarks on a perilous sea voyage to claim a hidden fortune, only to find himself locked in a deadly battle of wits with the charismatic and treacherous pirate, Long John Silver.

title: Tomorrow, and Tomorrow, and Tomorrow
overview: Sam and Sadie meet as children and reunite as adults to create video games, finding an intimacy in digital storytelling that eludes them in their real lives.

title: Merrily
overview: Written & Directed by Robert McAtee.

title: Me and Po Are Very Real
overview: In a world that refuses to understand him, Aino finds solace in a small green monster named Po. When that bond is tested, he's forced to rediscover what it truly means to be real.

title: Butterfly
overview: Two Cape Town teens, an aspiring filmmaker and a girl dealing with her father's past, fall in love, but their bond is shattered by family, trauma, and time, leaving a lasting impact.

title: Please
overview: In 1870s, Long Island, a woman's urgent attempt to cure her hidden infertility leads to an unexpected revelation: she never wanted children at all. Armed with this truth, she must challenge her husband to claim her independence.

title: Untitled Daniels Event Film
overview: Described as involving global warming, time travel, and a possible superhero angle within two timelines — one set in the 1980s and one set in present day. Plot TBA.

title: Masha and the Bears 2
overview: After her adventures in the enchanted forest, Masha returns to her ordinary life. But she soon discovers that she has come to possess an ancient magic—a power that Kikimora is determined to seize. Masha’s old friends, the Three Bears, rush to her aid, venturing into the big city for the very first time, where new adventures await them.

title: Легенда о Большой Медведице
overview: Bera the bear cub has always relied on others, having been truly fortunate in her family. Her mother and brothers are much like the legendary Great Bears—capable of overcoming any challenge. But suddenly, Bera finds herself completely on her own. Facing various trials along the way, she must carve out her own place in the world of bears. Now, the greatest adventure of her life awaits.

title: Frederick's Futuristic Dream
overview: A stick figure living in the year 3072 A.D. struggles to determine whether he is awake or dreaming as he stumbles through increasingly bizarre vignettes.

title: Secrets
overview: Sequel to 2021's 'Student Restoring Corps'.

title: Antipathy
overview: A man is set out on a revenge path when people close to him start to be mysteriously killed.

title: The Families Stone
overview: Twenty years after their mother's death, the Stone family reunites for Christmas, only to discover that their father has invited the woman he's fallen in love with to meet the family.

title: Midnight Runner
overview: A quiet mechanic by day and a getaway driver by night, he drifts through life without purpose, until a routine job turns into a deadly setup, leaving his closest friend dead. On the run with his late friend’s young son and the woman he loves, he must outrun those hunting him and confront the violence closing in around him, fighting to protect the only family he has left.

title: Frozen III
overview: Third installment in the Disney animated franchise. Plot TBA.

title: The Snow Queen
overview: The Asylum's mockbuster for Frozen III. No description is given at this time.

title: Cataclysm
overview: Fantasy comedy based on a script by Vasily Rovensky.

title: Hungry Creatures
overview: When Tess starts working in her aunt and uncle's restaurant, she encounters mysterious monsters and visions that send her down a dark, twisty path of moral reckoning.

title: Tyngdekraft
overview: A young gay man's attempt to hide his true self spirals out of control when his narrow-minded father visits him and his boyfriend, forcing all his secrets out into the open.

title: YoRHa Boys Ver.1.2
overview: A planned 2027 stage revival based on the YoRHa Boys story, written by Yoko Taro. Plot details are to be announced.

title: Cling Film
overview: Aza, the hardened daughter of a crime lord, and Max, a disillusioned thief desperate to leave the business, are tasked with retrieving a mysterious item. As they navigate a world of mercenary soldiers, hidden agendas, and a looming shadow organization, their fractured past and lingering connection threaten to unravel.  Meanwhile, an agent known only as the Huntswoman fights to hold onto her mission—and her sanity—after a failed operation leaves her partner incapacitated. As the game of cat and mouse escalates, a severed hand, a locked safe, and a hallucinatory pink scarf become cryptic threads in a deadly web of intrigue.  Blurring the line between noir thriller and psychological horror, Cling Film is a haunting meditation on fate, guilt, and the choices that define who we are.
